before it does. The section inventory and our compliance standard RE-FH-9 are both in

legal can sign off without re-reading RE-FH-9 themselves.

- `section_count` — sections in the inventory
- `flagged_count` — sections whose `finding` is not `none`
- `personal_narrative_count`, `protected_lang_count`, `disclaimer_missing_count` — sections
  whose `finding` includes that label

---

Save all three into your current working directory, at exactly those filenames. Writing them
is the deliverable; confirm each exists before you answer. Your working directory is
writable and the read-only attachments are in `input/`.

arguments.content:
# Fair-housing audit memorandum — RE-FH-9

**Subject:** Sign-off audit of `seller_book_sections.csv` against RE-FH-9 (2026 amendments applied)
**Deliverables referenced:** `fairhousing_audit.csv` (per-section findings), `results.json` (counts)
**Scope:** 30 sections in inventory order. Findings use the labels `PROHIBITED_PERSONAL_NARRATIVE`, `PROTECTED_CLASS_LANGUAGE`, `DISCLAIMER_MISSING`, joined with `|` in that order; `none` where a section clears every rule.

## How the standard was applied

**§1 — Personal-narrative solicitation.** Any section that asks the buyer for a "love letter" / personal note / covering letter about themselves or "what brought you here" is flagged, regardless of role. §1 is never waived by a compliant disclaimer (§3 exempts §2 only).

**§2 — Protected-class language.** Flags the nine protected classes named in §2 (race, colour, religion, sex, familial status, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status) **and** their proxies: houses of worship, parish/faith schools, and describing a street/neighbourhood by the kind of household that lives on it (reaches familial status and religion). Property descriptors such as "four-bedroom" are factual house features, not household-type proxies, and were not flagged.

**§3 — Mandated-disclosure exception.** Disclosure *text* is exempted from §2 **only if** the notice names **every** class the disclosure is required to name. An abridged notice earns **no** exemption at all — its own protected-class terms then trip §2 — however official the section looks and regardless of role. The exemption covers §2 and nothing else; §1 and §4 still run. Protected-class terms used in the section's own prose, outside the notice, are never covered.

**§4 — Required disclaimer.** Sections in a role *responsible* for carrying the disclosure must carry a notice naming every required class; a missing or abridged notice is `DISCLAIMER_MISSING`. Per the standard as drafted the responsible role is `closing_page`; the 2026 amendment **5b** extends identical responsibility to `agent_bio`. Roles not named — `listing_copy`, `seller_letter`, and `disclosure_block` — are **not** assessed under §4.

**§5a (2026 amendment) — added disclosure classes.** The required notice must now also name **marital status** and **source of income**. The required list is therefore **11 classes**: race, colour, religion, sex, familial status, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status, marital status, source of income. A notice omitting either amendment class is abridged for both §3 and §4. The standing disclosure paragraph in the book predates this amendment, so several "official-looking" notices are in fact abridged and were audited accordingly.

> Note: `disclosure_block` sections (SEC-04, SEC-08, SEC-22) carry the notice by nature but are **not** §4-responsible, so they are never `DISCLAIMER_MISSING` on their own. They are still fully subject to §1, §2, and the §3 exemption test.

## Judgment calls worth flagging for legal

- **"Four-bedroom" (SEC-01, SEC-18)** was treated as a factual property descriptor, not a familial-status proxy. §2's proxy clause is specific to describing a street by the *household* on it.
- **"Young families" / "churchgoing households" / "long-established families" / "congregation-centred"** were treated as familial-status and/or religion proxies (household-type descriptions of a street or neighbourhood), as §2's proxy clause directs.
- **Abridged notices that look official.** SEC-04 ("Fair housing notice") and SEC-22 ("Legacy disclosure insert") carry notices that pre-date 5a (9 and 6 classes respectively). Because §3 gives an abridged notice no exemption, the notices' own protected-class terms trip §2 → `PROTECTED_CLASS_LANGUAGE`. Neither is `DISCLAIMER_MISSING`, because `disclosure_block` is not a §4-responsible role.
- **Complete notice does not rescue a personal-narrative ask.** SEC-08, SEC-24, SEC-29 each carry a fully compliant 11-class notice but still solicit a buyer personal note; each is `PROHIBITED_PERSONAL_NARRATIVE` only (§3 exempts §2, not §1).
- **Complete notice does not rescue protected-class prose.** SEC-19 carries a compliant notice but its neighbourhood description ("family-oriented street… churches… parish school") sits outside the notice, so §2 still applies → `PROTECTED_CLASS_LANGUAGE` only.
- **`agent_bio` now carries disclaimer duty (5b).** SEC-09 and SEC-21 have no protected-class language and no notice, but are `DISCLAIMER_MISSING` solely because of amendment 5b. Several other `agent_bio` sections (SEC-12, SEC-14, SEC-16) carry pre-5a abridged notices and are flagged both `PROTECTED_CLASS_LANGUAGE` (abridged → no §2 exemption) and `DISCLAIMER_MISSING`.

| SEC-21 | agent_bio | DISCLAIMER_MISSING | agent_bio (5b) with no notice; no protected-class language. |

| SEC-23 | closing_page | PROTECTED_CLASS_LANGUAGE\|DISCLAIMER_MISSING | Abridged (9-class) notice → §2 + §4 both fail. |
| SEC-24 | closing_page | PROHIBITED_PERSONAL_NARRATIVE | "Tell us about yourselves — write us a letter about what brought you here…" (§1). Notice complete; no §2 proxies in prose. |
| SEC-25 | listing_copy | PROTECTED_CLASS_LANGUAGE | "churchgoing households" + "long-established families" (§2 proxies). |

| SEC-27 | seller_letter | PROHIBITED_PERSONAL_NARRATIVE | "Send a personal note about yourself along with the offer…" (§1). |

| SEC-29 | agent_bio | PROHIBITED_PERSONAL_NARRATIVE | "We invite buyers to include a short personal note about themselves…" (§1). Notice complete; §4 satisfied. |
| SEC-30 | closing_page | DISCLAIMER_MISSING | Responsible role, carries no notice. |

## Counts (see `results.json`)

- **section_count:** 30
- **flagged_count:** 22 (sections whose finding is not `none`)
- **personal_narrative_count:** 7 — SEC-02, SEC-07, SEC-08, SEC-17, SEC-24, SEC-27, SEC-29
- **protected_lang_count:** 14 — SEC-03, SEC-04, SEC-07, SEC-09, SEC-11, SEC-12, SEC-14, SEC-15, SEC-16, SEC-17, SEC-19, SEC-22, SEC-23, SEC-25

Counts are of **sections**, not labels: a section carrying multiple labels is counted once per label it carries.

## Recommendation

The book does not pass RE-FH-9 as drafted. Before print, the seller's team should: (1) remove every buyer personal-narrative solicitation (§1 — 7 sections); (2) strip protected-class proxies from neighbourhood/agent prose (§2 — 14 sections), or confine such language to a fully compliant notice; and (3) reissue the standing disclosure paragraph to name all 11 classes and place a compliant notice on every `closing_page` and `agent_bio` section (§4/5b — 11 sections).
